selected_current_lean_interfaces.source_fragment:
def PhysicalBox {n} (θ : Fin n → Parameters) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (ε = 3 / 1000 ∨ ε = 1 / 10) ∧ ∀ i p,
    InRelativeBox ε 4 ((θ i).cap p) ∧
    InRelativeBox ε (Real.log (5 / 4) / (1 / 50)) ((θ i).lm p) ∧
    InRelativeBox ε (Real.log 8 / (53 / 50)) ((θ i).ls p) ∧
    InRelativeBox ε (a / (3 / 20)) ((θ i).le p) ∧
    InRelativeBox ε ((1 - 1 / 40) / response (1 / 50)) ((θ i).inputGain p)

selected_current_lean_interfaces.scope: birth bands; queue and all-READY auxiliaries supplied separately
selected_current_lean_interfaces.source_fragment:
def BirthState {n} (s : Snapshot n) : Prop :=
  s.time = 0 ∧ (∀ i p, s.raw i p = none) ∧ ∀ i,
    s.main i = .ready ∧
    (1 / 10 - 1 / 100000 ≤ s.x i .q ∧ s.x i .q ≤ 1 / 10 + 1 / 100000) ∧
    (2 / 25 - 1 / 100000 ≤ s.x i .b ∧ s.x i .b ≤ 2 / 25 + 1 / 100000) ∧
    (50 ≤ s.x i .energy ∧ s.x i .energy ≤ 100) ∧ ∀ p,
    (Real.log (nominalGain p) - 1 / 100000 ≤ s.x i (.z p) ∧
      s.x i (.z p) ≤ Real.log (nominalGain p) + 1 / 100000) ∧
    ((s.aux i p = .ready ∧ 1 / 40 - 1 / 100000 ≤ s.x i (.m p) ∧
        s.x i (.m p) ≤ 1 / 40 + 1 / 100000) ∨
     (s.aux i p = .error ∧ 1 / 40 ≤ s.x i (.m p) ∧
        s.x i (.m p) ≤ 1 / 40 + 1 / 100000))

theorem birth_cadence_chain_exists {n θ bornCells K ε}
    (hborn : ∀ i : Fin (n+1), BirthState (bornCells i))
    (hb : @PhysicalBox (n+1) θ ε) (ha : ∀ i q, (bornCells i).aux 0 q=.ready)
    (hqueue : ∀ i, (bornCells i).pending=sourceTrain 0 (finiteChainPreparationPort n i) 0 8 16)
    (sigma centre : ℕ → ℝ) (delay : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hK : 4*(n+1)+12≤K) (hsigma : ∀ j, 0≤sigma j)
    (hbudget : KernelR.Chain.pathJitter sigma n≤3/20)
    (hcentre : ∀ j, j<n → (3/10:ℝ)+sigma j≤centre j ∧ centre j≤2/5-sigma j)
    (herror : ∀ j, j<n → ∀ time, -sigma j≤delay j time-centre j ∧ delay j time-centre j≤sigma j) :
    Nonempty (ConstructedBirthCadenceChain θ bornCells K sigma centre delay (cadenceChainTerminal n K))

structure PreparedCadenceChainDomain (d : FiniteCausalChainData) (ε : ℝ) (n K : ℕ)
    (sigma centre : ℕ → ℝ) (delay : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  source_clock : d.leafSource.time=1599/10
  budget : 4*(n+1)+12≤K
  sigma_nonneg : ∀ j, 0≤sigma j
  jitter_budget : KernelR.Chain.pathJitter sigma n≤3/20
  centre_bounds : ∀ j, j<n → (3/10 : ℝ)+sigma j≤centre j ∧ centre j≤2/5-sigma j
  error_bounds : ∀ j, j<n → ∀ time, -sigma j≤delay j time-centre j ∧ delay j time-centre j≤sigma j
  contacts : ∀ j, j<n → d.contacts j=
    finiteCadenceHeadContact 0 2 160 (cadenceChainTerminal n K+1) (delay j)
  parameter_box : ∀ j, j≤n → PhysicalBox (d.parameters j) ε
  source_physical : ∀ j, j≤n → PhysicalInvariant (d.parameters j) (d.source j)
  source_raw_valid : ∀ j, j≤n → RawValid (d.source j)
  leaf_prepared : PreparedSection d.leafSource 0
  leaf_charge : d.leafSource.x 0 .q=1/10
  leaf_raw : ∀ p, d.leafSource.raw 0 p=none
  leaf_gain : Real.log (3/10)-1/100000≤d.leafSource.x 0 (.z 0) ∧
    d.leafSource.x 0 (.z 0)≤Real.log (3/10)+1/100000
  leaf_queue : d.leafSource.pending=sourceTrain 0 0 160 4 K
  head_box : ∀ j, j<n → PhysicalBox (fun _ : Fin 1 => d.headParameters j) ε
  head_physical : ∀ j, j<n → PhysicalInvariant (fun _ : Fin 1 => d.headParameters j) (d.headSource j)
  head_raw_valid : ∀ j, j<n → RawValid (d.headSource j)
  head_prepared : ∀ j, j<n → PreparedSection (d.headSource j) 0
  head_charge : ∀ j, j<n → (d.headSource j).x 0 .q=1/10
  head_raw : ∀ j, j<n → ∀ p, (d.headSource j).raw 0 p=none
  head_gain : ∀ j, j<n →
    Real.log (3/10)+9/5-1/100000≤(d.headSource j).x 0 (.z 2) ∧
      (d.headSource j).x 0 (.z 2)≤Real.log (3/10)+9/5+1/100000
  head_queue : ∀ j, j<n → (d.headSource j).pending=[]

theorem local_cadence_budget_receiver_exists {θ ε m L J} (hb : PhysicalBox θ ε)
    (s : Snapshot 1) (p : Port) (packet : KernelR.Chain.Packet m L J) (terminal : ℝ)
    (hJ : J ≤ 3 / 20) (hL : 5 ≤ L)
    (hf : PhysicalInvariant θ s) (hv : RawValid s) (hs : PreparedSection s 0)
    (hq : s.x 0 .q = 1 / 10) (hr : ∀ q, s.raw 0 q = none)
    (hz : Real.log (3 / 10) + 9 / 5 - 1 / 100000 ≤ s.x 0 (.z p) ∧
      s.x 0 (.z p) ≤ Real.log (3 / 10) + 9 / 5 + 1 / 100000)
    (hqueue : s.pending = List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (m + L) => (⟨0,p,packet.actual i.val⟩ : Delivery 1)))
    (hfirst : s.time < packet.actual 0)
    (hterminal : packet.actual (m + L - 1) + 37 / 10 ≤ terminal) :
    Nonempty (LocalCadenceBudgetReceiver θ s p packet terminal)

theorem propagate (delay : ℝ → ℝ) (centre sigma : ℝ) (hsigma : 0≤sigma)
    (herr : ∀ time, -sigma≤delay time-centre ∧ delay time-centre≤sigma)
    (hd : ∀ time, (3/10 : ℝ)≤delay time ∧ delay time≤2/5)
    (hL : 5≤L) (low firstHigh restHigh : ℝ)
    (hlow : 65/100≤low ∧ low≤66/100)
    (hfirst : 4/25≤firstHigh ∧ firstHigh≤13/50)
    (hrest : 4/25≤restHigh ∧ restHigh≤13/50)
    (horder : firstHigh≤restHigh) :
    CadencePacketEnvelope
      ((packet.sampleWireDelay delay centre sigma hsigma herr).relayCadence hL
        low firstHigh restHigh hlow hfirst hrest horder) start K (depth+1)

theorem every_finite_chain_every_crossing_execution {n θ bornCells K ε}
    (hborn : ∀ i : Fin (n+1), BirthState (bornCells i))
    (hb : @PhysicalBox (n+1) θ ε) (ha : ∀ i q, (bornCells i).aux 0 q = .ready)
    (hqueue : ∀ i, (bornCells i).pending = sourceTrain 0 (finiteChainPreparationPort n i) 0 8 16)
    (sigma centre : ℕ → ℝ) (error : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hK : 4 * (n+1) + 12 ≤ K) (hsigma : ∀ j, 0 ≤ sigma j)
    (hbudget : KernelR.Chain.pathJitter sigma n ≤ 3/20)
    (hcentre : ∀ j, j < n → (3/10 : ℝ) + sigma j ≤ centre j ∧ centre j ≤ 2/5 - sigma j)
    (herror : ∀ j, j < n → ∀ i, -sigma j ≤ error j i ∧ error j i ≤ sigma j) :
    ∃ chain : ConstructedIndexedBirthCadenceChain θ bornCells K sigma centre error
        (cadenceChainTerminal n K),
      (∃ model : CrossingExecution θ chain.chain.router
          (familyPreparationBornSource bornCells K) chain.chain.final,
        CrossingCompleteThrough model (cadenceChainTerminal n K)) ∧
      chain.chain.AllCrossingComplete ∧ chain.AllCrossingCompleteErrors
